title: Page 7
slug: 良膳小娘子下-子纹-面对偏心偏到天边去的家人赵小丫这世学聪明了-被当奴婢使唤嫁给傻子换银子的烂事绝不会再发生-娘亲与姊姊
content_zh:
卫元召的眉头轻皱，“照娘亲所言，她出嫁之后，你们应该再无交集，为何还有她对你有恩一说？”

宋氏闻言，脸上露出一抹为难。

“娘。”卫元召追问：“你别隐瞒。”

“娘也不是要瞒你。我怀着同儿那年，你爹接旨进京赴任，因我大腹便便，你又不足三岁，为免路上颠簸，当时便带着你和你祖父、祖母暂留光州。当时大雪严寒，你祖父病得没有胃口……”宋氏垂下眼，幽幽说道：“我带着你出门，想要找找街上可有鲜鱼可买，可惜天寒地冻，没人摆摊。

“我转而带你回外祖家求助，却不小心在途中摔了，动了胎气，正好遇上随着夫君进城来回娘家的刘氏。危难之时，她对我伸了援手，让我在刘家产子，不然我和同儿可能凶多吉少。”

想起那日，宋氏不由得一叹，“刘氏一心帮娘，害得自个儿也动了胎气，只是庆幸老天保佑，她身子养得好，生得倒比我还早，母女均安。”

宋氏依稀记得自己痛得快晕过去前听到婴儿啼哭，还有什么“胎记、有福”之类的话。

卫元召听得紧皱眉头，大雪严寒还让大腹便便的儿媳妇带着稚子出门？他嘲弄一哼，“娘，是祖父或祖母逼你去买鲜鱼才是吧。”

宋氏神情微动，但最终浅浅一笑，柔声说道：“是或不是不重要，那都过去了。”

卫元召一口气难受的梗在心口，看来祖父、祖母许久以前就对娘亲不满，并非是在进京时才变的。

宋氏瞒着，更多是为了这个家的平和，爹不是傻子，应该是看在眼里，所以这么多年以来始终维护着娘亲，如今他也懒得去论对错，只是问：“当时娘亲在刘家产子，身边可有旁人？”

宋氏不解卫元召为何有此一问，但还是怒力的回想，“刘氏的兄长欠下外债之后，因怕债主上门，抛下爹娘不知踪迹。当时刘屠夫病得严重，就只有刘氏和她娘亲在我身旁。”

“娘……”卫元召为难的开口，“你肯定你当时产下的是男丁？”

宋氏直觉回答，“我自然是肯定的。”

“如何肯定？是娘自个儿亲眼所见？”

宋氏脸上浮现踌躇，当时产子时她晕了过去，等醒过来，孩子已经摆在自己的身旁，刘氏的娘说她生了个大胖小子，如果她生的不是男丁，又是什么？

“召儿，你怎么问这等荒谬的问题？”

卫元召沉下脸，瞪着宋氏，“看来娘亲自个儿都无法肯定。”

宋氏被卫元召看得心惊了下，“召儿，娘被你弄糊涂了。”

“娘可知赵家有两女？”卫元召追问。

“自然知道。”宋氏点头，“这些年为了感激刘氏，我都会寄些布料、粮食、补身药材至赵家，偶尔书信往来。”

“既是多年有所连系，刘氏长女名为赵雪，么女呢？”

这个问题着实问倒了宋氏，这些年与刘彩凤书信往来，在信中只看刘彩凤提及赵雪如何好，倒是很少听刘彩凤提及么女。

她也不是没有问过，但她记得爹彩凤说这孩子无续，不讨人喜爱，不想多提，所以她也就没再问。

“娘，今日我才知，刘氏拿着你送上的布料、粮食、补身药材将赵雪千娇万宠的养大，么女却是连个正经名字都没有，就浑叫着小丫——赵小丫。”

赵小丫？宋氏想起笑起来眯着眼的可人姑娘，竟是刘氏的么女？她的思绪有些溷乱，明明就是温和有礼，怎会不讨人喜？她都巴不得有这么个懂事的闺女。

“娘，你好好的仔细想想，你产子那日可有任何不对之处？”

宋氏再迟顿也明白了卫元召的言下之意，她摇着头，“不可能，不可能……”

“娘。”卫元召坚持，“仔细想。”

“我昏了过去。”宋氏像是失了力气，沮丧万分，“什么都不知道。”

卫元召一时血气翻涌，前所未有的愤怒袭来，“若是不知道，我就把人抓到你面前，让你弄个清楚。”

“召儿？”宋氏看着卫元召转身冲了出去，心头一惊，连忙跟在后头急呼。

卫元召脚步没停，在月洞门前差点撞上刚下朝的卫阁老。

“毛毛躁躁成何体统！”卫阁老不由得轻斥。

卫元召欲言又止的看了卫阁老一眼，最终只是双手一拱，飞快的奔离。

卫阁老皱着眉头，他从未见过这孩子如此急躁，随后看到宋氏跟着跑出来，他立刻手一以伸，扶住了她，“这是怎么了？一个个的都不成体统。”

“老爷。”宋氏只觉心慌意乱，反手捉着卫阁老，“召儿方才跟妾身说了些奇怪的话，妾身越想越不明白。”

卫阁老挑了挑眉，安抚的拍了拍宋氏的手，“无事，你慢慢跟我说说，天大的事都有我呢。”

宋氏被卫阁老坚持扶进房里，定下心之后，终于将当年产子一事娓娓道来。

第二十章 身世大白(1)

在昆阳侯府等了好一会儿，卫元召一看到慢条斯理出来的周屹天，立刻问：“人呢？”

周屹天的神情淡淡，“谁？”

卫元召的嘴张了张，心情复杂，“小丫。”

“她歇了。”

卫元召皱眉看着外头，太阳才西下，时辰尚早，这就歇下了？

“等你成亲便知道了。”

周屹天淡淡的一句话令卫元召气得快要吐血，“周屹天，你不是人！”

上茶的周岳看卫元召一脸气急败坏，心想自己的主子果然是高人，连温文儒雅的卫大人都快被他气疯了。

周屹天喝着茶，冷眼看着气恼的卫元召。

“我派人去找赵雪和她娘，你——”卫元召心里憋得慌，吸了口气，好不容易将气给压下，“你让小丫到卫府一趟。”

若今日没将事情查个水落石出，他无法入眠。

“你先回吧。”周峻天没说好也没说不好，只是将杯子放在桌上，站起来，头也不回的走了。

“周屹天！”卫元召气得瞪着周屹天的后背。

周岳对卫元召不由心生同情，上前轻声说了句，“卫大人放心，只要是对夫人好，我家爷都会做的。”

赵小丫与周屹天成亲之后，奴才们都改口叫夫人。

卫元召闻言怒火稍消。

周岳又补了句，“大人可以派人上永安坊瞧瞧。”

卫元召眼睛一亮，他原本担心找不到刘彩凤的落脚之处，周岳这么说，他还管什么不明白的，立刻离开侯府。

回到正房的周屹天脱下沾了寒气的外袍，在炉边站了会儿，这才上了床。

赵小丫动了下，周屹天手一捞，将人给搂进怀里。

她迷迷糊糊的在他怀里找了个舒适的位置，带着睡意问道：“卫大人何故前来？”

“邀你上卫府做客。”他用了做客二字，赵小丫是他的人，跟卫家没有关系，他低头亲了亲她的脸颊，“你喜欢卫夫人吗？”

她窝在他的怀里，虽不懂他为何会突然有此一问，但还是老实答，“喜欢。”

他的手摸着她露在锦被外的圆润肩膀，触感极好，令人想要咬上一口，“如果她是你娘，你开心吗？”

她忍不住失笑，这会儿终于瞎开眼睛，抬头看着他的黑眸，“这是怎么了？想让我认义母？”

“在漠北，看到你信中及提及赵家所施恩之人是卫夫人后，我便派顾良回山村去査了趟。”

周屹天不会无缘无故提及不相干的事物，赵小丫坐起身，将衣裙穿回身上。

周屹天撇了下嘴，若能选择，他情愿与赵小丫窝在床上，但他知道自己离京在即，事情越快解决越好。

Wei Yuanzhao frowned slightly, "According to what my mother said, after she got married, you should have no contact with each other again. Why is she still being kind to you?"

Hearing this, Mrs. Song showed a hint of embarrassment on her face.

"Mother." Wei Yuanzhao asked, "Don't hide it."

"Mom didn't mean to hide it from you. When I was pregnant with our son, your father received an order to go to Beijing to take office. Because I was pregnant and you were less than three years old, he took you, your grandfather, and your grandmother to stay in Guangzhou temporarily to avoid the bumps on the road. It was snowing and cold, and your grandfather was so sick that he had no appetite..." Mrs. Song lowered her eyes and said quietly: "I took you out to look for fresh fish to buy on the street, but unfortunately it was cold and no one set up a stall.

"I took you back to my grandfather's house for help, but I accidentally fell down on the way and had a fetal infection. I happened to meet Mrs. Liu who was following her husband into the city and back to her parents' home.In times of crisis, she lent a helping hand to me and allowed me to give birth at Liu's house, otherwise my son and I would have been in trouble."

Thinking of that day, Mrs. Song couldn't help but sigh, "Ms. Liu was so dedicated to helping her that she even had fetal motility. Fortunately, God blessed her and she was well-kept and was born earlier than me. Both mother and daughter are safe."

Mrs. Song vaguely remembered hearing the baby crying and saying "birthmark, blessing" before she almost fainted from the pain.

Wei Yuanzhao frowned when he heard this. It was snowing and freezing and he let his potbellied daughter-in-law take her child out?He snorted mockingly, "Mom, it was your grandfather or grandmother who forced you to buy fresh fish."

Mrs. Song's expression changed slightly, but in the end she smiled slightly and said softly: "It doesn't matter whether it is yes or no, that's in the past."

Wei Yuanzhao felt an uncomfortable feeling in his heart. It seemed that his grandfather and grandmother had been dissatisfied with his mother a long time ago, and they did not change when they came to Beijing.

The Song family kept it secret, mostly for the sake of the peace of the family. His father was not a fool, and he should have seen it, so he has always protected his mother for so many years. Now he is too lazy to discuss right and wrong, and just asked: "At that time, my mother gave birth to the child in the Liu family, was there anyone else around her?"

Mrs. Song didn’t understand why Wei Yuanzhao asked this question, but she still recalled angrily, “After Mrs. Liu’s brother owed foreign debt, he left his parents without a trace because he was afraid that the creditor would come.At that time, Butcher Liu was seriously ill, and only Mrs. Liu and her mother were by my side."

"Mother..." Wei Yuanzhao said awkwardly, "Are you sure you gave birth to a boy?"

Song answered intuitively, “Of course I am sure."

"How to be sure?Did your mother see it with her own eyes?"

Hesitation appeared on Ms. Song's face. She fainted when she was giving birth. When she woke up, the child was already beside her. Mrs. Liu's mother said that she had given birth to a big fat boy. If she didn't give birth to a boy, what was it?

"Zhao'er, why do you ask such a ridiculous question?"

Wei Yuanzhao lowered his face and glared at Mrs. Song, "It seems that my mother is not sure."

Mrs. Song was shocked when she saw Wei Yuanzhao, "Zhao'er, mother is confused by you."

"Do you know that there are two daughters in the Zhao family?"Wei Yuanzhao asked.

"Of course I know.Mrs. Song nodded, "In order to express my gratitude to Mrs. Liu these years, I would send some cloth, food, and body-replenishing medicinal materials to the Zhao family, and occasionally exchange letters.""

"Since we have been connected for many years, the Liu family's eldest daughter is named Zhao Xue, who is her daughter?"

This question really troubled the Song family. In the past years of correspondence with Liu Caifeng, she only saw Liu Caifeng mentioning how good Zhao Xue was, but rarely heard Liu Caifeng mention this girl.

It wasn't that she hadn't asked before, but she remembered that her father Caifeng said that the child would have no continuation and was unlovable, so she didn't want to mention it more, so she didn't ask again.

"Mom, I just found out today that Madam Liu raised Zhao Xueqian in a loving way with the fabrics, grains, and body-building herbs you gave her, but the girl didn't even have a serious name, so she just called her Xiaoya—Zhao Xiaoya."

Zhao Xiaoya?Mrs. Song thought of the lovely girl who smiled and narrowed her eyes. Is she Liu's daughter?Her thoughts were a little confused. She was obviously gentle and polite, how could she not be lovable?She wished she had such a sensible daughter.

"Mom, think about it carefully. Is there anything wrong with you on the day you gave birth?"

No matter how late she was, Mrs. Song understood the implication of Wei Yuanzhao's words. She shook her head, "Impossible, impossible..."

"Mother." Wei Yuanzhao insisted, "Think carefully."

"I fainted."Ms. Song seemed to have lost her strength and was extremely frustrated, "I don't know anything."

Wei Yuanzhao's blood surged for a moment, and unprecedented anger struck him, "If you don't know, I will arrest him in front of you and let you find out clearly."

"Zhao'er?" Mrs. Song was shocked when she saw Wei Yuanzhao turn around and rush out, and quickly followed behind and shouted.

Wei Yuanzhao didn't stop and almost bumped into Mr. Wei Ge who had just left the court in front of the moon cave gate.

"How unbecoming it is to be frizzy!"Mr. Wei Ge couldn't help scolding him lightly.

Wei Yuanzhao glanced at Mr. Wei Ge hesitantly, but in the end he just cupped his hands and ran away quickly.

Mr. Wei Ge frowned, he had never seen this child so impatient, and then when he saw Mrs. Song running out, he immediately stretched out his hand to support her, "What's going on?Every one of them is inappropriate."

"Master.Mrs. Song felt flustered and grabbed Elder Wei Ge with her backhand, "Zhao'er just said something strange to me. The more I think about it, the more I don't understand.""

Mr. Wei Ge raised his eyebrows and patted Mrs. Song's hand reassuringly, "It's okay. Please tell me slowly. I'm responsible for all big things."

Mr. Song insisted on being helped into the room by Mr. Wei Ge. After calming down, she finally told the story of giving birth to a child.

Chapter 20: Life experience revealed (1)

After waiting in Kunyang Hou Mansion for a long time, Wei Yuanzhao saw Zhou Yitian coming out slowly and immediately asked: "Where is the person?""

Zhou Yitian's expression was indifferent, "Who?"

Wei Yuanzhao opened his mouth with complicated emotions, "Xiaoya."

"She rested."

Wei Yuanzhao frowned and looked outside. The sun had just set. It was still early, so he stopped now?

“You’ll know when you get married."

Zhou Yitian's faint words made Wei Yuanzhao so angry that he almost vomited blood, "Zhou Yitian, you are not a human being!"

Zhou Yue, who was serving tea, saw Wei Yuanzhao's angry face and thought that his master was indeed an expert. Even the gentle and elegant Master Wei was almost driven crazy by him.

Zhou Yitian drank tea and looked at the angry Wei Yuanzhao coldly.

“I sent someone to find Zhao Xue and her mother, you—” Wei Yuanzhao panicked, took a breath, and finally suppressed his anger, “You asked Xiaoya to come to the Wei Mansion."

If he doesn't get to the bottom of the matter today, he won't be able to sleep.

“You go back first."Zhou Juntian didn't say yes or no, he just put the cup on the table, stood up, and left without looking back.

"Zhou Yitian!"Wei Yuanzhao glared at Zhou Yitian's back angrily.

Zhou Yue could not help but sympathize with Wei Yuanzhao, and stepped forward and said softly, "Don't worry, Mr. Wei, as long as it is good to my wife, my father will do it."

After Zhao Xiaoya and Zhou Yitian got married, all the slaves changed their name to Madam.

Wei Yuanzhao's anger subsided slightly after hearing this.

Zhou Yue added, "Your Excellency, you can send someone to Yong'anfang to take a look."

Wei Yuanzhao's eyes lit up. He was originally worried that he would not be able to find Liu Caifeng's place to stay. But after Zhou Yue said this, he didn't care what he didn't understand and left the Hou Mansion immediately.

After returning to the main room, Zhou Yitian took off his outer robe that was stained by the cold air, stood by the stove for a while, and then went to bed.

Zhao Xiaoya moved, and Zhou Yitian grabbed her hand and pulled her into his arms.

She drowsily found a comfortable position in his arms, and asked sleepily: "Why are you here, Lord Wei?""

“I invite you to be a guest in the Wei Mansion."He used the word "guest". Zhao Xiaoya was his and had nothing to do with the Wei family. He lowered his head and kissed her cheek, "Do you like Mrs. Wei?"

She nestled in his arms. Although she didn't understand why he suddenly asked this question, she still answered honestly, "I like it."

His hands touched her round shoulders exposed outside the brocade quilt. The touch was so good that he wanted to take a bite. "If she were your mother, would you be happy?"

She couldn't help laughing, and now she finally opened her eyes and looked up into his dark eyes, "What's going on?Do you want me to recognize my adoptive mother?"

"In Mobei, after I saw in your letter that the person the Zhao family was benevolent to was Mrs. Wei, I sent Gu Liang back to the mountain village to investigate."

Zhou Yitian would not mention irrelevant things without reason. Zhao Xiaoya sat up and put her dress back on her body.

Zhou Yitian pouted. If he had a choice, he would rather stay in bed with Zhao Xiaoya, but he knew that he was leaving Beijing soon, and the sooner the matter could be resolved, the better.
